svg.title: One planner, three remote agents
svg.desc: The planner of the kit is a tall machine on the left with a slot for each of three lanes, in the order that the planner log records. In each lane the planner calls a remote agent, drawn as a machine with its port and skills, and the agent puts its task on a tray, one slip per state. test-runner completes with 13 passed, drawn as 13 cells on its top. code-reviewer asks which base branch to use, the planner answers main, and the task completes with one finding. deployer waits in TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED, the planner follows the task with SubscribeToTask, an operator outside A2A approves, and the task completes.
